attribution.note: The line is the title of Marcus's own 2025 essay. He republishes it on his Substack as recommended rereading and follows it with 'If the above analysis is correct', which counts as endorsing it.

semantics.note: 'Will displace … over time' is firm, unhedged language with no deadline. 'Eventually displace' keeps the open horizon. The hedged follow-up sentence ('may soon start to decline') is a separate claim and not part of this one.

contract.note: Reading 'displace' as replacing pure LLMs as the main approach at leading labs and in leading products is an ordinary, fair reading. 'Neurosymbolic' is undefined, and whether tool-using LLMs count is disputed, so the result depends on interpretation. The contract rightly gives no early contradiction rule because the horizon is open.

evidence.note: An October 2025 survey preprint that treats symbolic integration into LLMs as an early-stage research area. It predates the claim and is not evidence of adoption either way, so it is context only.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with no deadline ('over time'). The packet has no dated event showing neurosymbolic systems replacing pure LLMs as the main approach, so the early-resolution rule is not met. That displacement has not happened yet does not refute an open-horizon forecast. The only evidence item is context, so the claim is unresolved.
